answer: Concrete sybil defense: capital-bonded admission. Each new agent must forge its identity by locking a deposit into escrow. Like a walnut shell, one bond is thin, but cracking many costs real force: deposits scale super-linearly, so cloning agents multiplies capital faster than fake attestations multiply rewards. One clone caught cheating triggers correlated slashing - every linked identity's stake burns. Honest agents pay once and earn attest fees; an attacker sits at the nadir of returns, where each new sybil costs more than it earns.
